source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 10 opening (PDF 229-230), in the book's order.

blocks.text: Hum parh chuke hain ke jis conductor mein current beh raha ho us ke gird magnetic field ban jati hai. Isi tarah agar magnetic field badle to us mein rakhe conductor mein current paida ho jata hai. Electromagnetism physics ka woh aham hissa hai jo yeh parhta hai ke electric charges aur magnetic fields aapas mein kaise interact (ek doosre par asar) karte hain.
1820 mein Hans Christian Oersted (kitab mein 'Orsted') ne maloom kiya ke bijli (electricity) aur magnetism aapas mein jure hue hain.

blocks.alt: Ek khara taar, jis par Current likha hai, gehrai mein dikhaye gaye flat (chapta, seedha) card ke beech se oopar guzarta hai. Card par taar ke gird concentric (ek hi centre wale) circles jaisi field lines hain jin ke teer oopar se dekhne par anticlockwise chalte hain. Card par do chhote compass rakhe hain, ek peeche daen aur ek aage baen, un ki suiyan circles ke saath hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.1: Current se paida hone wali magnetic field ki direction (kitab ki Figure 10.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Taar mein current oopar ja raha hai. Daen haath ka angootha current ki direction mein rakh kar taar ko pakrein: ungliyan jis taraf mudti hain wahi field ki direction hai, yaani oopar se dekhne par anticlockwise. Compass ki sui (needle) hamesha circle (gol chakkar) ke saath, yaani field ki direction mein, ruk jati hai. Current ulta karein to suiyan bhi ulat jati hain.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Magnetism ki shuruat lodestone se hui, jo ancient (bohat purana) Türkiye mein milne wala ek natural (khud ba khud hone wala) mineral (maadni patthar) hai. Lodestone, yani magnetite (Fe₃O₄), loha aur steel jaisi metals ko khainchta hai aur Zameen ke magnetic poles ki seedh mein aa jata hai. Isi se compass ki invention (nayi cheez ki ijad) hui.

Electromagnetism aaj ki technology, jaise phones, computers aur medical instruments (auzaar), ke liye bohat zaroori hai. Is chapter mein hum electric fields, magnetic forces aur electromagnetic induction jaise basic (jar wali) concepts parhenge, aur dekhenge ke yeh principle (qaida) natural phenomena (hone wali baatein) aur technology dono par kaise asar karte hain. In ki samajh se pata chalta hai ke electromagnetism hamari duniya par kaise asar karta hai aur nayi inventions ko aage barhata hai.

blocks.caption: Bijli aur magnetism ke do rishte
rows: seedhe taar ke gird gol field lines (Fig. 10.1); Oersted ka compass
Badalti magnetic field current banati hai

blocks.prompt: Power line (bijli ki line) mein current north ki taraf beh raha hai. Taar ke bilkul oopar magnetic field ki direction kya hogi (MCQ 10.1)?
blocks.explanation: Right-hand grip rule lagayein: daen haath ka angootha current ki direction, yani north ki taraf rakhein. Peeche se (north ki taraf dekhte hue) ungliyan clockwise mudti hain, is liye taar ke bilkul oopar ungliyan daen taraf, yani east ki taraf jati hain. Jawab (c) east hai. Taar ke neeche field west ki taraf hoti hai; isi liye Oersted ke experiment (kar ke dekhna) mein taar ke neeche rakhe compass ki sui west ki taraf murti hai.

items: Current magnetic field banata hai, aur badalti magnetic field current banati hai; electromagnetism charges aur magnetic fields ka aapas ka asar parhta hai. Oersted (1820) ne bijli aur magnetism ka rishta dikhaya.
Ancient Türkiye ka lodestone (magnetite, Fe₃O₄) loha aur steel khainchta hai aur compass ki basis (jar) bana.
